Maria (AM): Quick question from ACME POC — legal asked for our incident/notification timeline for Hosted API vs Private deployment. Need short, copy-paste language for the SOW. Can @Jen - Security and @Riley - Legal advise?

Jen - Security: For Hosted: our standard line is to notify customers without undue delay and no later than 72 hours after discovery of a confirmed security incident affecting customer data. We also send interim updates (typically every 24 hours) until containment.

Jen - Security: For Private/VPC/on-prem: default is that notification obligations to regulators/customers remain the customer's responsibility; we commit to supporting investigation and providing findings within agreed SLAs (e.g., 48–72h for triage) — but the SOW should say notifications will be coordinated with the customer.

Sam (Solutions Eng): Helpful — buyer specifically asked whether we ever do <24h notifications for Hosted (their regulator expects faster timelines).

Jen - Security: Short answer — depends on regulation. For GDPR-style breaches we aim for 72h. For contractual/regulatory regimes requiring faster timelines (some healthcare or local privacy laws) we can negotiate tighter windows in the contract. Avoid blanket promises in the SOW.

Alex S: Can we provide a short clause they can paste into their questionnaire / SOW?

Riley - Legal: Suggested starter clause (feel free to trim):

```
Incident Notification. Redwood will notify Customer without undue delay and, where legally required, no later than seventy-two (72) hours after becoming aware of a Confirmed Security Incident that materially affects Customer Data. Redwood will provide supplemental status updates as reasonably requested and will cooperate with Customer to support regulatory notifications. Notification does not constitute admission of liability.
```

Maria (AM): This is great. For Private deployments should we include an explicit line about 'Customer-led notifications, Redwood assistance'?

Riley - Legal: Yes — add: "For Private deployments, Customer is responsible for regulatory notifications; Redwood will assist and provide relevant technical evidence within the agreed response windows." Keeps responsibilities clear.

DevSecOps Bot: Runbook + templates: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/incident-response (internal) — includes notification templates, stakeholder matrix, and SIG/CAIQ mappings for IR questions.

Sam (Solutions Eng): For the POC I'd propose we offer: Hosted — 72h standard; Private — coordinate with customer, Redwood supports with investigative deliverables within 48–72h. That covers most buyers.

Alex S: I'll paste Riley's clause + Jen's notes into the buyer reply. Can someone give a quick LGTMs so I can send?

Jen - Security: LGTM :thumbsup:

Riley - Legal: Approved.

Maria (AM): I'll add a short note about escalation contacts and send to ACME now. Thanks everyone! :pray:
